        s.account_id,
        s.seats AS purchased_seats,

            WHEN s.seats <= 200 THEN 'Large (51-200)'
            ELSE 'Enterprise (201+)'
        END AS account_size_bucket,
        p.tier
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN plans p ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id
    WHERE s.status = 'active'
),
active_users AS (
    SELECT

        COUNT(*) AS active_user_count
    FROM users

    a.tier,

        WHEN 'Medium (11-50)' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Large (51-200)' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Enterprise (201+)' THEN 4
